description: Trace placed or embedded images into vector artwork (Object > Image Trace > Make, or Make and Expand with expand: true), with a preset and any Image Trace panel option: mode, palette, colours, grays, threshold, paths, corners, noise, method, fills, strokes, stroke width, snap curves to lines, ignore white and view. Returns each tracing with its path, anchor and colour counts

colorFidelity.description: Colors with a full-tone palette: colour fidelity, percent

colorGroup.description: Colour group in that library, or "All"

colors.description: Colors: the most colours a limited palette uses

corners.description: Corners: how readily corners form, percent

expand.description: Expand the result into ordinary paths straight away (Make and Expand). Default false

grays.description: Grays: grey levels in grayscale mode, percent

ignoreWhite.description: Ignore White (black and white mode, abutting method)

library.description: Palette from a swatch library: "Document Library" or the name of an open swatch library

maxStrokeWeight.description: Stroke: widest line traced as a stroke, pixels

noise.description: Noise: smallest area traced, in pixels

palette.description: Palette: limited (up to colors) or full_tone (colorFidelity). Colour and grayscale modes

paths.description: Paths: how closely paths follow the pixels, percent

preset.description: Tracing preset to start from, as list_tracing_presets gives it (brackets, case and spacing are optional), e.g. "High Fidelity Photo", "6 Colors", "Black and White Logo". The options below override it

target.description: Placed or embedded images (place_image gives ids)

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

threshold.description: Threshold for black and white mode: brighter pixels become white

view.description: View: what the tracing shows on the artboard

name: trace_image
title: Trace Image
